body.x: NEWJAK Co., Ltd. (CEO Jung Hae-hyun) participated in CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition, held in Las Vegas from January 6 to 9, showcasing its XR and spatial computing technologies and accelerating its global market expansion.

At CES 2026, NEWJAK unveiled ‘SporTrack,’ a next-generation solution that integrates the company’s core technologies. SporTrack is the world’s first XR board game built on NEWJAK’s proprietary spatial perception and tracking technology. It enables immersive interaction by utilizing real-world spaces without the need for wearable devices. Recognized for its high level of technological sophistication and differentiated market potential, SporTrack won the CES Innovation Award in the “XR & Spatial Computing” category. The award signifies official recognition of its commercial viability beyond the experimental content stage.

body.cap: International visitors experience the XR board game ‘SporTrack’ at NEWJAK’s booth during CES 2026.The immersive spatial computing technology, delivered without the need for wearable equipment, drew strong attention on site. | Photo by NEWJAK

body.x: During the exhibition, NEWJAK operated a dedicated hands-on experience booth where visitors could directly experience the core functionalities of SporTrack. The booth was designed to demonstrate spatial perception and tracking technologies that can be deployed instantly without complex installation processes or equipment, allowing buyers to evaluate the solution in realistic deployment scenarios. Designed with a wide range of B2B and B2G applications in mind—including retail, education, sports, and entertainment—the booth attracted strong interest from global industry stakeholders.

This achievement is particularly noteworthy as it follows NEWJAK’s double award win at CES last year with ‘X-RUNNER,’ marking the company’s second consecutive year of receiving CES Innovation Awards. Having already accumulated extensive proof-of-concept experience across education, sports, and entertainment sectors in the domestic market, NEWJAK plans to leverage these references to advance full-scale global business partnerships and distribution discussions, with a strategic focus on North America and Europe, led by SporTrack.
